items.title: Victor Coleman’s Hudson Pacific Properties posts $218M loss
items.summary: Hudson Pacific Properties' Victor Coleman with Sunset Bronson Studios (LinkedIn, Sunset Studios, Getty)The losses keep on coming at Victor Coleman’s Hudson Pacific Properties. The office and studio REIT posted a $218 million loss for the third quarter, worse than the $136.5 million same time last year. HPP blamed write-downs and losses on office deals in San Francisco.
